architecture.mechanism: Motion-compensated frame rate up-conversion using combined motion vectors to reduce artifacts
architecture.intervention: Apply motion-compensated interpolation principles to model and predict corrosion progression on the frame and driveline, using combined forward/backward estimations with adaptive thresholds to interpolate corrosion-prone zones and identify optimal locations for preventive coatings.
architecture.expected_effect: Improved targeting of corrosion prevention treatments, reducing premature rust formation on new vehicle frames and driveline components.
architecture.falsification_test: Compare corrosion onset locations predicted by the adapted interpolation model against actual rust development on a sample fleet of new trucks over 24 months; the model is falsified if predicted and actual corrosion zones fail to correlate above a statistically significant threshold.
